lines: Your first venture guides you through buying stock, listing, packing, shipping, and getting paid. Gold arrows and button highlights show your next step.
Part-time jobs, product photos, packing, coding, and consulting use hands-on minigames. Better work produces better results.
Time follows the city: fast-forward and short naps are removed. Sleep becomes available in the evening.
Each screen explains itself on first use; its help button lets you read the explanation again.
Each game has its own save slot. Starting another game keeps your existing games, and replacing a full slot preserves a backup.
First-venture deliveries and the first sale arrive quickly. Normal supply and shipping times return after the tutorial.
Maya helps you resume the tutorial when loading a game, and coding exercises focus on a few key lines.
Money, dates, and scores use clearer number fonts. Movement slides around corners and collides with the base of furniture.
Late arrivals can work a shorter shift when at least 2 hours remain before closing, with pay based on hours worked.
Chinese notifications, signs, contact roles, clothing status, and tutorial headings are translated.
The tutorial recovers pending stock deliveries in older saves, keeps your day pass, and continues from the step you reached.
After a tiring shift you can return home to sleep. The first venture allows sleep after 4 PM and guides you home when it is too late to work.
While your first parcel travels, the tutorial takes you to Bloom Coffee to find a job.
Time keeps moving while using the computer or phone. Reading cards, pause menus, minigames, and story decisions pause the clock.
Chinese line wrapping and the city's interiors, characters, and expressions have improved.
Chapters 7–9 add supply shocks, greener packaging and products, a green-business grant, and international payment choices.
Management lists keep their scroll position. Story goals recover from declined contracts and difficult cash-flow months.
Harbor logistics adds a van, warehouse, delivery routes, and drivers. Chapters 10–12 cover escrow, frozen payments, compliance, and an acquisition offer.
Older saves receive missing fields automatically so you can keep playing.
Chinese tutorial headings now use the bundled fallback font in browsers, preventing missing-character boxes.
Eligible purchase orders can be canceled or returned. The operations list keeps recent orders and orders you can still act on.
Closing a company cancels its outstanding offers and deliveries and prevents invoices from being collected twice.
City Guide and interaction markers read the current building data. Only open businesses are listed.
Active retail demand and delivery costs have been balanced. Save export, import, and three recovery backups help protect your progress.
